content.text:
Super common at 28 months, since a lot of toddlers get wary of green foods around now. Try putting a tiny portion of something green on their plate next to a food they already like, with no pressure to eat it. Eat some yourself in front of them. It often takes a bunch of calm exposures before they'll taste it, and letting them touch, smell, or just push it around counts. If it's a long-running refusal of whole food groups, mention it to their doctor.

Also, I told you earlier I couldn't sign a child up for things. That's changed: if you send me a program's registration page and say yes, I can try signing them up.
